altText: AI-generated fashion editorial of four adult women seated close together in a shaded open-air desert pavilion. A woman in a green-and-red crescent-and-star dress rests her head against a blonde woman in a crimson outfit. The other two lean toward their joined hands, with one placing a hand on the other shoulder. Rainbow knee-high legwear and colorful platform boots and heels contrast with the cream cushions and layered desert ridges behind them.
